title: Ashen Delta: The Diplomat's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the diplomat must negotiate a route across a disputed threshold using a sealed bilingual accord.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the mutual passage covenant; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the mutual passage covenant.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the sealed bilingual accord.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to reveal the faction's old promise
